title: objectql: run async after-hooks on commit of the triggering unit (drop on rollback)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czrwT7WKAde95kC4cg

Follow-up of #33651 / PR #33703, filed per seat ruling amendment 6892365442 (option a in the p1, option b here).

## Problem
After #33703, an async (fire-and-forget) after-hook runs detached from the triggering write's unit, so its writes no longer fail with "Transaction query already complete". But it still STARTS before that unit commits. On a multi-connection database (Postgres, MySQL, Mongo) its `ctx.api` reads and writes run on their own connection and can see the state from before the triggering write (an async afterUpdate re-reading its record reads old values; an async afterInsert updating the new row or inserting a child that references it finds no row). If the unit rolls back, the hook has already run. Review record: #33703 comment 6892346943.

## Ask
Queue async after-hooks on the unit and dispatch them when it settles: run on commit, drop on rollback. objectql's transaction unit has no general commit-callback registry today (the only `onCommit` is the batch-data response builder in metadata-protocol), so this is new mechanism.

## Acceptance
- Async after-hooks fired inside a door unit or a caller `engine.transaction()` / `ctx.api.transaction(fn)` run only after commit, and not at all on rollback; outside any unit, behaviour unchanged.
- Pins for commit, rollback, nested units, and blocking + async on the same event; a real-driver twin (knex/Postgres or sqlite) in packages/qa/dogfood.
- Owns the prose: `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts:353-355` (HookEvent docblock: ctx.api writes "roll back with everything else" → blocking hooks only) and `hook.zod.ts:559` (async semantics), plus `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` once the behaviour is "after commit".
- Declare Clause-② / Metadata-protocol per AGENTS.md (likely semantic: async hooks gain a defined ordering).

- Also owns `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md:64` ("in the background, after commit"): reword to match the behaviour this card ships. That is a governed skills/** edit (Tier H) and Fable-mandatory per dispatch-gates. Per seat ruling amendment 6892365442 (#33703), moved here from #33703.
